description:
Which of the 21 wheat genome assemblies of the UWA graph pangenome (Chinese Spring, ArinaLrFor, Cadenza, Claire,
Jagger, Julius, Kariega, Lancer, Landmark, Mace, Mattis, Norin61, Paragon, Renan, Robigus, Stanley, Weebil, Fielder,
Zang1817, Attraktion, Aikang58) carry each stretch of graph sequence: presence/absence variation beyond genes.
Region mode: region = 'chrom:start-end' on Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 (<= 10 Mb), or gene = a symbol / IWGSC ID
(its v1.0 position +- flank). Returns how much Chinese Spring sequence each assembly lacks there, the variable
intervals (largest first), and non-reference sequence (present in other assemblies, not Chinese Spring) inserted
in the region, anchored by the graph's flanking Chinese Spring segments. assembly = another assembly id (e.g.
Wheat_Cadenza) with region on that assembly's own sequence names: only the non-reference graph sequence that came
from that assembly has coordinates there.
Group mode: present_in / absent_in = cultivar lists -> intervals in all of present_in and none of absent_in
(genome-wide, or one chromosome), with totals and the largest intervals. Can combine with region or gene.
min_length = smallest interval reported (bp).
name: wheat_segment_pav
